intent.goal: Create a believable casual phone photograph of a young woman laughing naturally at a café, not a polished stock image.

subjects.description: young adult woman seated at a small café table
subjects.appearance: natural facial asymmetry, visible skin texture, loose hair with a few flyaways
subjects.pose_action: turning toward a friend just off camera while laughing, one hand resting naturally beside a coffee cup
subjects.expression: mid-laugh, eyes slightly narrowed, unaware of the camera

composition.camera_angle: eye level from the next table
composition.perspective: subtle stranger POV without surveillance tension
composition.foreground: soft edge of a chair and cup partially entering frame
composition.background: busy neighborhood café with imperfectly aligned chairs and window reflections

camera.focus: face in focus, not tack-sharp everywhere
camera.motion: tiny motion softness in hair and gesturing hand

lighting.exposure: slight highlight lift on the window side of the face
lighting.color_temperature: mixed cool daylight and warm interior practicals

look.texture: real skin, fabric weave, glass reflections
look.post_processing: very light phone processing, no beauty filter, no HDR punch

anatomy_checks: natural five-finger hand resting beside cup
